To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, procurement@horizonhealth.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Privacy questionnaire: minimization + access evidence

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the call last week. As part of our DPA review and onboarding checklist we need a compact evidence package demonstrating:

- PII minimization controls (what fields are collected, why, and where they're retained)
- Recent access snapshot showing which Redwood roles had access to production PII (past 30 days)
- Any subprocessors that handle identifiers and the contractual constraints applied

Could you please provide a single bundle (PDF/zip) with a short cover note and the artifacts above? Procurement will also need an annotated CSV mapping data elements to retention categories.

Target timeline: by end of day Wednesday, 2025-07-02. If that's not possible, let us know what you can deliver sooner.

Appreciate it — our DPO will review and come back with any clarifying questions.

Best,
Ava Lin
DPO, Horizon Health

Thanks Sean / Marissa — that plan sounds good. A couple of quick clarifications before you send the bundle: 

- For the minimization matrix, can you mark which fields are considered "identifiers" vs. "derived" data?
- For the access snapshot, we primarily need confirmation that no third-party contractors (non-Redwood subprocessors) had direct access to unredacted identifiers in the last 30 days. If you can provide an explicit yes/no and evidence pointer in the CSV that will help speed internal sign-off.
- Please include an attest statement from Redwood Legal confirming the redaction process and a contact for follow-up (name + email).

If you can provide the initial bundle earlier (partial artifacts are fine) we can start our internal review and surface any follow-ups quickly.

Best,
